description: Employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week. Must be available during core hours 10am-4pm. Manager approval required for full remote positions.
Full-time employees receive 20 days PTO per year. PTO accrues monthly at 1.67 days. Unused PTO can roll over up to 5 days to next year.
Business travel must be pre-approved by manager. Economy class for flights under 6 hours. Hotel limit $200/night in major cities. Per diem $75/day for meals.
New employees receive laptop and monitor. Equipment refresh every 3 years. Personal devices allowed with MDM enrollment. Report lost devices within 24 hours.
All code changes require at least 2 approvals. PRs must include tests with 80% coverage. Security review required for authentication changes.
Customer data retained for 7 years. Employee data retained for 5 years after termination. Marketing data deleted upon unsubscribe request within 30 days.
All positions must be posted internally for 5 days. Interview panel must include diverse members. Background checks required for all new hires.
Report security incidents to security@company.com immediately. Do not attempt to investigate on your own. Preserve all evidence and logs.
